latest_release.name: Tinycast 0.12.15
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Keep the compact bar's glass shadow out of the window shadow on macOS 26 by @gilitos92 in #1872
* Copy snippets, choose the browser's default action, and pin snippets by @abue-ammar in #1881
* Hide a quicklink's prompt when its shortcut is pressed again by @abue-ammar in #1882
* Fix the AI chat accessibility crash and add web search to OpenAI and Anthropic by @abue-ammar in #1883
* Recognize Yandex Telemost meeting links by @abue-ammar in #1884
* Record a sandboxed app's staged image copy as an image by @abue-ammar in #1904
* Show a word count in Notes by @abue-ammar in #1905
* Move Tinycast to the com.abueammar.tinycast bundle id by @abue-ammar in #1910
* Group the calculator's numbers by the region's widths by @param1903 in #1908
* Repoint every saved path into the old bundle id's folders by @abue-ammar in #1912

## New Contributors
* @gilitos92 made their first contribution in #1872
* @param1903 made their first contribution in #1908

### ⚠️ One-time move: Tinycast Stable has a new app ID

This update moves Tinycast Stable to a new app ID, `com.abueammar.tinycast`, as part of the transition toward iCloud sync.

**Update in the app as usual: click Update, then Relaunch.** Tinycast reopens in a moment with everything you had: settings and shortcuts, clipboard history, notes, snippets (including their shortcuts), quicklinks, AI chats, extensions, window layouts and rooms. Open at Login stays as it was.

**macOS treats the new ID as a new app, so you'll need to do these once after updating:**

1. **Grant permissions again.** Open **Settings → Permissions** in Tinycast, or **System Settings → Privacy & Security**, and enable Tinycast for **Accessibility**, plus **Full Disk Access** if you use File Search. Until you do, pasting, snippet expansion, the Hyper Key and window commands won't work.
2. **Remove the old entry.** System Settings may now list Tinycast twice. The old entry no longer does anything: select it and click **–**.
3. **Re-enter your AI API keys and MCP secrets** in **Settings → AI**. They're still stored in your Keychain under the old ID. You can delete the old copies using Keychain Access if you like.

**Installing manually instead?** Download the **DMG**, not the `-Handoff.zip`, which is only intended for in-app updates from older versions. Your data will migrate in the same way, but you'll need to enable **Launch at Login** again in **Settings → General**.

<!-- tinycast:install -->

**Channel:** stable · **Version:** 0.12.15 · **Bundle ID:** `com.abueammar.tinycast`
Built from 6fa8ba1225be0777ef769f1816bffc7da213f91d. [Full changelog](https://github.com/abue-ammar/tinycast/compare/v0.12.11...v0.12.15)

Install via Homebrew, or open the DMG below and drag Tinycast to Applications:
```sh
brew install --cask tinycast
```

detail.readme:
Tinycast

A native macOS launcher for everyday productivity. Lightweight and open source.

Website · Install · Docs · Support


Built with SwiftUI and AppKit. No dependencies, no Electron, no telemetry. It runs your Raycast extensions, too. [Explore all features →](https://tinycast.dev/#features) For anything private, feel free to email [hello@tinycast.dev](mailto:hello@tinycast.dev). ## Install On an Apple silicon Mac with macOS 26 or newer: ```sh brew install --cask tinycast brew install --cask tinycast@beta ``` - **DMG:** notarized, download from [Releases](https://github.com/abue-ammar/tinycast/releases). Drag `Tinycast.app` to `/Applications`. - **Intel Mac:** install from [Homebrew tap](https://github.com/abue-ammar/homebrew-tinycast). ## Support Tinycast is free and stays free. If it earns a place on your Mac, consider supporting its development. Thank you!
